question: Where does most of the average American household's money go: housing, food, transport, health care or entertainment?
answer: Housing takes a third, but second place goes to transport, about 17%, ahead of all food at 13%, in the Labor Department's 2023 survey. A car costs money even standing still: it loses value, needs insurance, and is often bought on credit. Food feels bigger because it is paid for every week.
move: The costs paid once a year often outweigh the ones noticed every week.
source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Consumer Expenditures 2023
reference: US Bureau of Labor Statistics (2024) Consumer Expenditures in 2023, Consumer Expenditure Surveys annual release
ask: What did my car cost me last year, counting lost value, insurance and loan interest?

items.label: Food

items.label: Entertainment
items.note: Pets, toys, screens and outings: one dollar in twenty.

items.label: Transport
items.note: Mostly owning cars: buying, fuel, insurance. More than all food.

items.label: Housing

items.label: Health care
